prose: Simon Willison's October sponsors-only newsletter is out, with September's edition now public as a free preview. Subscribers ($10/month) get each month's curated digest of LLM developments a month before the open version.
highlights: Willison's October sponsors newsletter published; September edition now free as a preview
basis: Cache is ok but the page is a short sponsors notice (503 chars); the newsletter content itself is paywalled to sponsors.
